heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 96–73, title I, § 111(b), Sept. 29, 1979, 93 Stat. 541

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 91–518, title VIII, § 801, Oct. 30, 1970, 84 Stat. 1339; Pub. L. 93–146, § 14, Nov. 3, 1973, 87 Stat. 554; Pub. L. 93–496, § 10, Oct. 28, 1974, 88 Stat. 1531; Pub.
